headline: Minimum wage rises for 11th consecutive year; business groups call for supporting measures to ease burden on SMEs | Industry & Economy
summary: Taiwan's Minimum Wage Review Council set next year's minimum monthly wage at 30,900 yuan, a 4.745% rise. The General Chamber of Commerce asked for changes to labour and health insurance cost-sharing.
why: Minimum wage increases raise labour costs for employers, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, and can feed into wage levels and consumer prices across the economy.
